sentences.en: Your success depends upon whether you work hard or not.
sentences.zh: 你的成功取决于你是否努力。

sentences.en: Whether you will succeed or not depends on your efforts.
sentences.zh: 你是否会成功取决于你的付出。

sentences.en: Our success depends on whether he helps us or not.
sentences.zh: 我们的成功取决于他是否帮助我们。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de+pend（悬挂）→悬挂着的→依靠，依赖

collocations.zh: 依 靠， 信 赖
